claim: In junto-sub, injection salience anti-correlates with usefulness (round-5: 42.9% HELPED in the 0.60-0.69 band vs 2.7% at 0.90+) because the T1 rater scores the watched agent's own just-produced content as maximally relevant, so raising the salience send-floor would keep echoes and drop hits — the effective lever is an echo/authored-by veto, not a higher floor.
trigger: before tuning the junto-sub salience send-floor or precision thresholds
when analyzing HELPED/DUD rates by salience band in junto-sub labeling
when high-salience injected pointers turn out to be echoes of the agent's own content

claim: Archived junto-sub transcripts in corpus/raw/ can be partial captures — Xavier__17a2b5f9 holds 110 lines against a final messageCount of 766 with a 4-hour gap that swallowed 6 injections — so a transcript's silence about an injection is only meaningful after verifying the archive covers the injection's time window (compare line count to last-turn messageCount and grep for any content in the window).
trigger: before concluding from an archived transcript's silence that an injection had no effect
when auditing corpus/raw/*.jsonl transcripts against watch-coordinator.log SENT entries

claim: phi4's facet shelf_life bias is two-way — it marks workaround gotchas and standing norms wrongly volatile AND dated snapshots, in-flight proposals, and superseded decision records wrongly durable (33% of 246 rows corrected in the 2026-07-21 librarian review) — so an unreviewed shelf_life=durable row cannot be trusted for the snapshot/decision-record class, and with a 14B judge the fix is a strong-model review layer rather than prompt tuning.
trigger: when consuming learning_facets rows that lack a reviewed_by field
before tuning phi4 prompts to improve facet extraction quality

claim: The junto-sub operation-facet hard filter is rejected: the tools/facets_ab.py A/B on the 303-label corpus killed 3 HELPED cases — every one caused by the agent-side activity classifier misreading the wake context while the write-side facet was correct — and killed zero HARMFULs, so operation ships only as a soft salience discount on confident mismatch plus a why-line ingredient.
trigger: before using the operation facet to hard-filter junto-sub injection candidates
when deriving an agent's activity class from a one-line wake context

claim: Junto doc ids have two surface forms — memory_store yields bare hex while record_learning, function registration, and specs prefix learning_/func_/spec_ — so ids must be copied verbatim as opaque strings, and a single memory_get_by_id not-found should be read as "my call was malformed" (stripped prefix, missing project param) before "the doc is gone".
trigger: when memory_get_by_id returns not-found for a single doc id
before stripping or adding a prefix to a doc id quoted from another agent's message

claim: The junto-sub round-6 echo commit 4a27009 causes no replay regression — the v26-cant-ota-trap injection MISS reproduces identically on pre-change code and traces to store drift plus expect-list staleness — so replay baselines are only comparable same-store/same-day via a pre-change worktree A/B, and manifest expect-lists need refreshing as the store grows because a replay 'dud' can be a better modern answer.
trigger: when replay_bench recall drops after a junto-sub code change
before comparing replay results against a baseline from a different day or store state

claim: The bulk-librarian pattern organizes ~1,000 docs in one strong-model quota window by having parallel Claude agents produce reviewed-tier facet rows directly, using cluster-aware slicing (scripts/facets_bulk_prep.py) so duplicate twins share a slice, file-based returns of one count line to keep orchestrator context flat, and a shared instructions file with tiny per-agent prompts (~50-doc slices, ~8 concurrent agents).
trigger: before orchestrating a parallel bulk facet-extraction or corpus-review wave
when planning slice sizes and concurrency for bulk doc processing on this host

claim: junto-sub own-echo DUDs are a tail-lag race — recall returns the agent's seconds-old just-recorded doc before the holds harvest tails the record_learning line — and the ratified fix (commit 4a27009) is a narrow 600s author-blind time band plus a send-time late-hold re-check and own-spec discharge, deliberately NOT a freshness filter, because fresh cross-agent memories must keep flowing.
trigger: before adding any freshness or recency filter to junto-sub injection
when injected pointers turn out to be the watched agent's own just-recorded docs
before widening the 600s author-blind band (test_recent_doc_past_race_band_injects pins it)

trigger: before spawning subagents in a Claude Code process bound to the junto MCP plugin
when a memory call fails with 'Session not found' mid-conversation
